[iac] Grant editor and IAP VM access to a registered developer (#11088)

Grant `roles/editor`, `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1`,
`roles/compute.osAdminLogin`, and `roles/iap.tunnelResourceAccessor` on
`hai-gcp-models` to the developer registered as `human-082`. The
principal already holds `projects/hai-gcp-models/roles/marindev` from
#10729. The new roles match those of `human-032` and `human-064`:
project
editing, plus sudo SSH to GCE instances through IAP TCP forwarding.

A reviewer should run `review-grant` to confirm the decrypted principal,
then `pulumi up` on the `marin` stack.

commits.author: loom-oa-dev[bot]
commits.message:
[rigging] Verify multipart S3 copies and abort failed uploads (#10639)

Hash promoted multipart S3 objects when their ETag changes, and compare
the result with the verified staging SHA-256 before publishing the
manifest. CoreWeave produced different ETags for identical bytes,
causing all 80 multipart objects in the reported transfer to fail
promotion.

Write S3 staging objects with autocommit disabled and commit only after
the source stream completes. A failed UploadPart now aborts the
multipart upload. Small one-part uploads are verified by SHA-256 because
their ETag shape changes; changed promotion ETags also require a
destination read. Live CoreWeave validation has not run.

Fixes #10638
Fixes #11081

---------

commits.author: loom-oa-dev[bot]
commits.message:
[iris] Keep pod exec failures from aborting controller ticks (#11076)

Keep a failed output-uploader exec from aborting Kubernetes controller
ticks. The Kubernetes client raises ValueError while parsing an OCI
runtime failure's nonnumeric cause as an exit code; that exception
stalled cw-rno2a dispatch with 80 tasks ASSIGNED and no pods.

Return a failed ExecResult for the malformed exit code and keep output
release exceptions local to one pod. The existing finalization deadline
still handles uploaders that cannot be released.

The affected-test run passed 1,348 tests and failed five evaluation
tests in Shellbox's local backend because this host lacks
`os.pidfd_open`. A focused evaluation case also failed from a separate
`main` checkout on this host.

Incident: https://marina.oa.dev/echo/wiki/947

Fixes #11075

Co-authored-by: loom <claude-max-1@openathena.ai>
